response:
Dear compatriot, I daresay I am not enamored with the prospect of igniting a conflagration of unbridled fervor, which might precipitate a calamitous conflagration, thereby besmirching the very fabric of our existence. Nay, I merely aspire to kindle a diminutive, yet fervent, spark within the recesses of thy heart.

Pray, permit me to propose a more modest endeavour, one that might serve to kindle a gentle, yet unyielding, flame, which might, in due course, ascend to a blaze of unquenchable ardour.
